newsitem.title: MADAGASCAR: Madagascar on alert for tropical cyclone.
newsitem.headline: Madagascar on alert for tropical cyclone.

text.p: Madagascan authorities put the northeastern coast of the Indian Ocean island on alert on Thursday as the tropical cyclone Daniela whipped up winds of up to 220 km per hour (140 mph).
The national meteorological office said Daniela was stationary on Thursday afternoon about 650 km (400 miles) off the northeastern town of Sambava, a vanilla-growing centre.
Daniela is the fourth cyclone of the season off Madagascar. The other three died away before hitting the land.
